feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Remembering 9/11. And, Vance, Trump urge voters to back Republicans in the midterms
entry.summary: NPR reflects on the events of 9/11 and the toll it left on the U.S. 25 years later. And, President Trump and Vice President Vance's convention speeches urge voters to back the GOP in the midterms.

entry.title: US diesel prices soar past $6 a gallon, deepening strain for hauling everyday goods
entry.summary: Diesel prices in the U.S. has hit yet another record, soaring past $6 a gallon on average as Washington's war with Iran disrupts the world's flow of fuel

entry.title: Will you get $5,000 to do the news quiz? No. But will it be fun? Maybe
entry.summary: Plus: donkeys, maps, art, iPhones and more!

entry.title: They cleaned up ground zero. Now many are hiding from ICE
entry.summary: After 9/11, thousands of rescue and cleanup crews went to work at ground zero. They were exposed to toxic debris and experienced psychological trauma. Today, many say they live in fear of deportation.

entry.title: Empty seats, socialism and Trump dominate the Republican midterm convention
entry.summary: The two day Republican convention in Dallas showcased the party's biggest asset in trying to win competitive midterm races and its greatest obstacle: President Trump.

entry.title: The U.S.-Canada trade war is creating a headache for auto-parts makers
entry.summary: For decades, the U.S. and Canadian auto supply chains have been tightly woven together. The trade war is threatening to unravel a complex system.

entry.title: From DOGE to space lasers, Alex Gibney peels back the many layers of Elon Musk
entry.summary: In the Oscar-winning filmmaker's latest documentary, director Alex Gibney investigates the rise of Elon Musk and says what's behind Musk's success are distressing truths.

entry.title: Trump administration allows TPS to continue for Salvadorans – for now
entry.summary: The Trump administration declined this week to terminate TPS for Salvadorans, even though it has done so for people from other countries like Haiti and Syria. But it also hasn't said whether it will extend the protection in the future.

entry.title: These Michigan swing voters are bracing for higher prices from trade war with Canada
entry.summary: President Trump's tariff standoff with Canada is rankling some key voters ahead of this year's midterm elections.

entry.title: On the 25th anniversary of 9/11, a divided U.S. gathers to remember and grieve
entry.summary: The U.S. marks the 25th anniversary of 9/11. Events will honor those lost, at a time when Americans are divided about the meaning and legacy of the terrorist attacks.
